title: Grateful Dead Live at Indianapolis State Fair Coliseum on 1973-10-27
lineage: MAC >> Reel 7.5 ips Revox A77 Reel @ 7.5 ips >> Revox A77 >> Akai GX636>Apogee Mini Me(24/96)>Apogee Mini Dac(monitoring/mastering)>Lynx One soundcard>Wavelab 5.0>FLAC

ai_review.summary: Audience recording captures a country‑rock flavored 1973 show with standout Loose Lucy, Wharf Rat > Stella and a smoking Greatest Story, delivered in decent but lively sound.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its solid setlist and energetic moments – funky Loose Lucy, the flowing Wharf Rat > Stella sequence and a scorching rendition of The Greatest Story Ever Told – while Jerry’s emotive vocals on Sugaree shine.  The audience‑sourced tape isn’t pristine, but it conveys the barn‑like ambience and liveliness that fans love.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate 4–5 stars, highlighting strong performances and a lively vibe; recording quality is decent but not flawless, yielding an overall high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Decent clarity with some ambient barn resonance; not the cleanest tape but captures the live energy and avoids the antiseptic sound of early soundboard recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transitions, notably Big River flowing into Playing Reprise and Wharf Rat into Stella; overall country‑rock feel with rock‑and‑roll lifts.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Emotive vocal and guitar work highlighted on Sugaree and throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith (keyboard) described as "on fire" during the performance.
